evals.prompt: Create a three-year budget model in XLSX with dynamic assumption cells, recalculate formulas, and verify layout.
evals.expected_output: Read financial-and-formula-modeling-standards.md and good-vs-bad-financial-model.md, separate assumptions from formulas, recalculate via xlsx/scripts/recalc.py, reopen with data_only=True, render to PDF/images, and visually inspect every sheet.
expectations: Uses dynamic formulas referencing assumption cells with zero formula errors
Recalculates via scripts/recalc.py and verifies cached values
Renders sheets and visually inspects for ### truncation or clipping

evals.prompt: Update two cells in an existing macro-enabled .xlsm workbook without losing macros or formulas.
evals.expected_output: Use OpenPyXL with data_only=False and keep_vba=True (never pandas round trip), preserve untouched formulas/macros, and note XLSM recalculation boundary.
expectations: Uses OpenPyXL with keep_vba=True rather than pandas
Does not run scripts/recalc.py on XLSM files
